name: Cloudflare Workers AI daily allocation
amount: 10,000 Neurons per day, shared across all models, reset at 00:00 UTC
summary: Daily free allocation on the Workers Free plan, covering chat, speech, image and embedding models hosted by Cloudflare. How far 10,000 Neurons go depends on the model. A few large models are excluded from the free plan. Going over doesn't bill you on the Free plan; requests fail instead.
source_note: Cloudflare Workers AI pricing docs, checked 2026-09-28.
